msg: AS BUILT after P8 fix a3: C_s 419 pF (7 x 56 + C320 27 pF) and C_shunt bank 27 pF (C204 only). THE PRIMARY ZVS BOUND OF THIS SWEEP, re-measured inside the sweep so it cannot drift away from classe_zvs_nominal.cir. Re-run this after ANY further value change on either bank.

The as-built populate must also deliver the power: 112.6 W at 30 V (decisions.md D11's 200 W at 40 V scaled by Vdd^2). A populate that reaches ZVS by starving the tank - which emptying the C_shunt bank alone on the pre-fix tank did - fails here, not on the ZVS bound.

NEGATIVE CONTROL, NOT A BOARD BOUND. Variant C is the RETIRED pre-fix populate (C_s 504 pF, C_shunt bank 83 pF) that this bench condemned, and it must STILL miss ZVS by a wide margin (measured 15.47 V). It is gated inverted - min, not max - because a deck that stops reproducing the known failure has stopped being evidence for the known fix, and every other number in kicad/sims/ rests on this deck's Coss card and stage model. If this ever passes the ZVS window, STOP and re-validate the deck; do not read it as good news.

The other half of the negative control: the retired populate delivered ~53 W of 112.6 W because the tank was detuned, and it must still do so. Warning severity - the ZVS half above is the load-bearing one.

THE BRING-UP MOVE, GATED. review-board.md W2 ships the instruction 'if ZVS lands late, pull C204 first'. On the as-built tank that empties the C_shunt bank entirely, and this bound says the board survives it. On the PRE-FIX tank the same move restored ZVS while leaving the stage at 59 W - which is why pout_bank0_w below is gated beside it.

THE TRAP, GATED EXPLICITLY. Emptying the C_shunt bank restores ZVS on almost any tank, including a detuned one - on the retired populate it gave 1.34 V at turn-on and only 59 W. Power must be gated alongside ZVS on every variant that claims to be a build, or the sweep would bless a populate that looks correct on the ZVS measure alone.

architecture/decisions.md SIM-2: worst Vds at turn-on across the EPC2019 device spread with the as-built populate, UNTUNED. Coss 110/150 pF and Qoss 18/23 nC (parts/C2836675.json) is a +28 percent charge spread with no absorber other than the trim bank (D2).

The max-Coss reel corner AFTER emptying the trim bank, i.e. after spending the bank's whole downward range. 12 V is where the bank runs out: below it the corner is fixable with parts, above it only the generator duty can close it (measured: D ~ 42-46 percent takes this corner to ~4.8 V, inside SIM-2's own duty_adjust_needed_pct <= 6). Calibrated so the typ-corner build passes with 10 V of margin and a bank one 56 pF step too full trips it.
Power at the max-Coss corner with the as-built populate. The corner must not cost more than ~10 percent of output.
architecture SIM-1's 1.29x derate on the 200 V BVDSS, applied to the as-built populate at the 30 V bench.
Same derate on the bank-emptied variant, which runs the highest drain peak of any reachable bring-up option.
The next populate step UP from as built (bank 56 pF instead of 27 pF). It also passes ZVS, which is the evidence that the shipped populate is not sitting on a knife edge between two reachable steps.
The max-Coss corner on the as-built populate, untuned. It loses ZVS (~12 V) but stays far inside SIM-2's 25 V untuned limit; the fix is to empty the bank, which is what the bank exists for (D2).
